name: VNX Gold
oneLiner: VNXAU is VNX's Liechtenstein-licensed gold token where each unit represents one gram of allocated physical gold vaulted under the FMA Blockchain Act.
collateral: Physical gold reported in custody at Philoro in Liechtenstein; the latest AUP reconciles 13,100 tokens to 13,100 gross grams but does not validate gold quality, value, legal rights, or physical presence
pegMechanism: Each VNXAU represents one gram of gold; verified VNX platform users can sell tokens through the platform and request physical collection or delivery from one-kilogram bar denominations

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At the 2026-07-13 cutoff, all four EVM deployments assigned asset-protection role 0 to issuer-controlled RBAC bearers that can freeze and unfreeze addresses, reclaim balances, and pause transfers. The Solana mint had a live freeze authority; Tezos role-0 bearers could freeze, unfreeze, and pause; and the Stellar issuer retained AUTH_REVOCABLE and AUTH_CLAWBACK_ENABLED. These are direct on-chain blacklist or equivalent balance-control powers.

mintAuthority.summary: VNXAU has seven independently mintable native deployments. Ethereum, Base, Polygon, and Etherlink use VNXDGR proxies with uncapped increaseSupply() access for every chain-local VNXManager role-0 bearer. Solana has one unrestricted SPL mint authority, Tezos has two unrestricted role-0 bearers, and Stellar has one effective master signer on the issuer account. No deployment enforces a global supply cap or timelock, no on-chain multisig was found, and off-chain MPC/HSM custody is unknown.

controls.label: VNXAU Solana mint and freeze authority
controls.capDescription: Classic SPL Token mint authority; no supply cap or mint allowance is enforced.
bypassSurfaces: The authority can rotate the mint and freeze authorities without a timelock.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432714278 (block height 410782389, hash 2zmgf9eoeHxnc8cU4jzyYSRPi8RkxAXhPWutQwR9w9ZS), this on-curve System Program account was both mint and freeze authority. One signature can mint without an on-chain cap. All 60 later mint-address transactions through the audit cutoff were checked and contained no authority mutation, so the state projects back to the exact slot. On-chain data does not establish whether the issuer uses MPC or HSM custody.

controls.label: VNXAU Stellar issuer master signer
controls.capDescription: The issuer account can issue arbitrary VNXAU units; Stellar assets have no protocol supply cap.
bypassSurfaces: The master signer can change signer weights, thresholds, and authorization flags immediately.
AUTH_REVOCABLE and AUTH_CLAWBACK_ENABLED permit trustline revocation and eligible-balance clawback.
controls.evidence: At Stellar ledger 63463325 (hash abd18d4cad6e6a0baf1bd42f9f95f4657fae28ac2a773a98a2a7640438730a1), the issuer state had last changed at ledger 62809173 and therefore was unchanged at the exact cutoff. Low, medium, and high thresholds were 0; the sole signer was the master key with weight 1, producing an effective 1-of-1 control because Stellar still requires account authorization. AUTH_REQUIRED was false, AUTH_REVOCABLE true, AUTH_IMMUTABLE false, and AUTH_CLAWBACK_ENABLED true. Off-chain MPC/HSM custody is unknown.

controls.label: VNXAU deployment-wide upgrade authorities
bypassSurfaces: Each EVM VNXManager role-0 bearer can self-grant role 1 and call upgrade or upgradeAndCall without delay.
Each EVM VNXProxyAdmin owner can change the proxy admin through the inherited owner path.
The Tezos owner can replace the implementation or RBAC contract through set_contract without delay.
The Solana Token program is immutable and the Stellar asset has no contract implementation, but their issuance authorities remain rotatable.
controls.evidence: At the exact cutoff, Ethereum role 1 was held by 0xacc5...311a and role 0 by 0x7b0c...9403, 0xacc5...311a, and 0x45a1...545a; proxy-admin owner was 0x7b0c...9403. Base role 1 and proxy-admin ownership were held by 0xd630...051f, while role 0 also included 0xacc5...311a and 0xb65a...09c6. Polygon role 1 was held by 0xacc5...311a, role 0 also included 0x7b0c...9403, and proxy-admin owner was 0x88f2...af4a. Etherlink role 1 was empty, role 0 included 0x21f5...59c1, 0xacc5...311a, and 0xb65a...09c6, and proxy-admin owner was 0x21f5...59c1. Any one listed EVM principal can reach an upgrade path immediately. Tezos owner tz1Rk3...dsm3 can replace implementation KT1SU44cZ3Jobc4tVA87TZa5JZVVY8CrdmXd or RBAC KT1KL1zq1BG4UHSagHDqXDhRuNtYnCY6u3qd.

review.evidence: Exact-cutoff state at 2026-07-13T20:34:40Z was reconstructed from Ethereum block 25526129 (hash 0xd2eca668433c517ab710c73c244a2545203f12b35a83e4fb521595be762bdc3f), Base block 48592766 (0xa99a4dae34debb8307285b94373592fafc63005a817dbf45d54d48607a821872), Polygon block 90179923 (0x64a5f7f3fc10d6571c92d89894aac431fb8a523db7eaeba33787b9604a0d34d4), Etherlink block 48196648 (0x921eee47831143a0374020ffe2015a8e172fee01de3baae7c31f1eaf692cd97a), finalized Solana slot 432714278 and block height 410782389 (2zmgf9eoeHxnc8cU4jzyYSRPi8RkxAXhPWutQwR9w9ZS), Tezos level 14047971 (BM9Cp1cVnVAa15NFHehSBPLonuNVh91MfZX4G5ggKhDtvd3YBJW), and Stellar ledger 63463325 (abd18d4cad6e6a0baf1bd42f9f95f4657fae28ac2a773a98a2a7640438730a1). Storage, role membership, EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon slots, code status, owners, program authorities, Tezos exact-level storage, and Stellar signers/flags were checked. All seven independent mint paths and every immediate authorization or upgrade bypass are represented above. No Safe or other on-chain multisig, timelock, guard, or cap was found; off-chain MPC/HSM custody remains unknown.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: VNXAU is an issuer-managed multichain gold token. Reviewed issuer/product sources show multichain issuance and transferability but no independent bridge protocol, so route risk is issuer-native multichain issuance.
